verifications.note: NMGC press release dated May 4, 2020, headlined 'CONSTRUCTION BEGINS ON SANTA FE MAINLINE LOOP': 'New Mexico Gas Company started construction Monday on a major infrastructure project, the Santa Fe Mainline Loop ... installing a new 20-inch pipeline along the route of the existing 12-inch pipeline ... a 35-mile route from Bernalillo to Santa Fe.' May 4, 2020 was a Monday, i.e. construction start = May 2020.

Albuquerque Journal, published May 21, 2020: 'A new $60 million, 35-mile gas pipeline to run from Bernalillo to Santa Fe ... The New Mexico Gas Company began work this month on the pipeline, to be laid parallel to the current mainline that now hugs I-25 northward from Placitas to Santa Fe, said utility Vice President of Engineering Tom Bullard.' 'This month' = May 2020, independently corroborating the press release's construction-start month/year.
